title: pm:mailbox: one mailbox per seat, not per account — today a second lane seat under the same account is never woken
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ③ ordered by the maintainer in the triage seat's session (2026-10-29): 「同意，直接立卡按席位开信箱」. It answers the question 「如果一个Claude code 账户开了多个车道，都能收到吗」, and the answer is no.

## Business reason

The mailbox PR is the only way to wake a seat that holds no PR conversation. Today it is keyed to the GitHub account, while one account routinely holds several lane seats. Only one session per account is woken; every other seat under that account misses its mail. Nothing tells the sender or the recipient. Lane-split notices, hand-offs and pull-backs sent this way can reach the wrong seat or no seat.

## Measured (on `origin/main`)

- `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`:
  - The branch is `mailbox/<login>` (`MAILBOX_BRANCH_PREFIX`), and the body opens with `Mailbox-of: <login>`.
  - Step ① refuses (exit 4) when the login already has an open mailbox: "One mailbox per account per repo" (header, ~L28).
  - Messages are `To: <login>` (~L174).
- `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` `mailboxLogin` (~L235) reads a mailbox back as a login, by head or by the `Mailbox-of:` line.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md` §信箱 PR says 「每项目至多一个 draft PR … 分支 `mailbox/<login>`」 and 「正文首行 `To: <login>`」. The opened PR body, however, says "one per seat, opened at seating, subscribed by the seated session". The two texts already disagree.
- The platform delivers a PR's activity events to one session at a time. A second session's `subscribe_pr_activity` succeeds but receives nothing while the first one holds the PR. So per-account means one woken seat per account.
- The live board:
  - os-sales holds at least three seats (two `domain:server` seats and `domain:ui#1`) behind one mailbox, #27357. Three `Notify: split` messages from `domain:ui` seats landed there today (13:05Z–14:27Z), and which os-sales session read them cannot be told.
  - os-bill holds `domain:ui` seats 2, 3 and 4 (#25995, #26620, …) and has no mailbox at all.

## Wanted

- **One mailbox per seat.**
  - The key is the seat, e.g. `domain:ui#4`.
  - The branch is `mailbox/<login>/<seat-slug>`, e.g. `mailbox/os-bill/ui-4` (a git ref cannot carry `:`).
  - The body opens with `Mailbox-of: <seat> · <login>`.
  - Messages open with `To: <seat>`.
- `mailbox-open.mjs`:
  - `--seat <seat>` is required.
  - It refuses a second open mailbox for the same seat, not for the same login.
  - `--close` is unchanged.
  - The self-test covers two seats under one login, both opening.
- `fleet-roster.mjs` reads the mailbox per seat row. A legacy per-login mailbox is read as "unassigned to a seat" and flagged, not silently attributed.
- `project-forms.md` §信箱 PR and the PR body template say the same thing:
  - Each seat opens one at seating, and the seated session subscribes.
  - It is closed at hand-over.
  - The seat-card hand-over steps name the close and the reopen.
- **Migration:** the three open per-login mailboxes (#27523, #27357, #27309) are closed by their accounts and reopened per seat once this lands. This is a card-thread follow-up, not part of this PR's diff.
- ⛔ The rest is unchanged: the `pm:mailbox` label, the ledger exclusion (`LEDGER_EXCLUSION`), "never merged, never readied, owes no CI", and the cloud-seat `--head` path.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:skills` lane (non-gate `scripts/pm/**` plus `.claude/**`, a governed surface: Tier H, the maintainer merges).

## Dedupe

Read every open issue whose title or body names `mailbox` or `信箱`: seat cards, the roster #25462 and a QA run only. None is a card for this. The origin is #25417 (closed), which introduced the per-account mailbox.
